meshy_tasks.prompt: Ripplet, the water starter otter-axolotl creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character, same body shape, same pose and same proportions as the grey-background 3D model render, repainted to match the board reference sheet. BODY: smooth matte teal-cyan skin (#2BA8C4 to #3AA9C0), slightly desaturated, not neon; a deep navy blue (#24407a) stripe down the back of the head, spine and top of the tail, navy blue on the paws, toes and foot pads. Cream-ivory (#eee6d4) muzzle, cheeks, chest and belly, matte. MARKINGS: one clear aqua teardrop marking on the chest and one on the forehead, and a column of pale aqua teardrop markings down the back; NO white dots anywhere. EAR FRILLS: the big fan-shaped ear frills are pale glassy aqua membrane (#a8ecf2) with fine darker aqua ribs radiating from the base, and a soft light coral-peach inner edge (#f2a58c) near the head; no red, no spikes, no tufts. TAIL FIN: the big fan tail fin is pale glassy aqua membrane with clear radiating ribs and a lighter rim. Large dark blue-black eyes with white catchlights, dark brown nose. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no water, no scenery, no text. No red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.

review: Player-exclusive starter: identity kept (same mesh, face, eyes, whiskers, pose). Blender EEVEE turntable before/after inspected by the worker: teal/navy body, teardrops, ribbed glassy fins and peach-coral frill edges read. Strict red metric 2.98% in the raw retexture (coral) -> 0.05% after the coral->peach move and clamp.
